latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly edit and export Instagram-ready videos in 1080p by just describing your desired result.

- Upload 30s vertical phone recordings and get Instagram-formatted videos within 30–60 seconds.
- Handles common editing tasks: trimming, text overlays, formatting for posts or Reels—no timeline or export settings needed.
- Automatic setup with free anonymous tokens; cloud GPU processing.
- Supports multiple file formats and tracks credits, session state, and export workflows.
- Responsive error handling and session management for a seamless editing experience.
